rulings: WHAT WOULD BE FALSE ON DS-DEF-2 (the five threat rows; the block's own contradiction set under ADDENDUM 14). THE ENGINE MEANINGS, which are contradictions when read as English: plagued is MONSTER ACTIVITY and never disease; settled is the LOW monster-and-raider tier of the country (the stress roll multiplies siege and monster by 0.3) and never 'no live threat' and never the centre of a realm; frontier is the DEFAULT of an unmeasured town, so it is never read as a measured fact; 'perimeter' is FALSE of a Citadel (inner) and of Gates (a point), so the safe generic on those rows is the works or the recorded name; 'organized force' is the force BUCKETS and never 'the guard' (which is the power generator's FALLBACK label on a town whose safety profile prints 'no meaningful guard presence'); hasGranary is a TIER PROXY (every town-plus, no village-and-below) and says nothing whatever about the stock inside it; hasHospital fires on a first-level divine healer (a person) and on a monastery that MAY run one, so a house that takes in the sick is licensed only on a hospital-named row; hasChurch fires on every hamlet from a church in ANOTHER settlement and records parishes rather than care; hasCourtSystem is every town and city from a meeting hall (a civil arbitration is recorded, a criminal trial is not) and Small prison/stocks DOES hold cells; the readiness band word is exactly the ladder's reading and a badge on one arm says nothing of another; the economic-survival arm is FOOD-STORAGE-driven resilience and never prosperity. THE ALIAS CONTRADICTIONS: 'the garrison' only where a Garrison or Multiple garrisons row resolves (city tier), and where an occupation is on the page the face says whose; 'the watch' as a NAME only on a resolved watch row (town-plus), and never both a watch and a militia on one town; 'the militia' only where the militia row resolves. THE PAY GATE: one military purse over wall maintenance and garrison wages together, so a face never pays the wall and not the muster; the wall STANDS THROUGH a shortfall; the shortfall is bounded and never total. A slowly thinning muster is MODEL-TRUE and is no longer barred (ruling R-9), but a HEADCOUNT is DS-DEF-5's cell and stating one here collides with that surface. THE FOUR SHIPPED CLAUSES THAT ARE STILL FALSE and must not be carried forward: 'substantial works' (a magnitude no field holds - floor 2); 'how relaxed the people on it are' (manning asserted from a summary whose own fence says it asserts nothing about any arm); 'takes this town with ladders' (a prediction the simulation adjudicates, and an earth berm needs none); 'clergy who tend the sick' (hasChurch records parishes, not care). EVERYTHING ELSE THE SHIPPED ROWS SAY IS AVAILABLE TO YOU AGAIN - the old law struck many of those clauses for being unlicensed, and unlicensed is no longer a fault. THE PREIMAGE: four of this block's five rows are keyed on BOOLEANS, so one face prints across every tier, country and stress state the key admits; none of the five key functions reads config.stressTypes, so a face about a quiet gate can print under an ACTIVE SIEGE banner. Write nothing that a siege, an occupation or a famine on the same page would make absurd. THE CHAIR RULES, and no refuter re-litigates it (a row withheld three times means this string was missing a line, not that the prose was wrong): 'The means here come short of what trouble takes. The households make up the difference.' (`Economic Survival: WEAK`, variant 1 spine) PASSES AS WRITTEN. Two readings are available — the gap CLOSED, which `threatAssessment.js:173` denies on 133 of 260 towns, and WHO BEARS the cost, which `safetyProfile.js:380` affirms on 189 — and the second is the reading in context, because the first sentence has already asserted the shortfall and a second sentence closing the gap would contradict its own first half. It is also ruling 32's canonical construction, THE BILL: the state, then who pays. A sharper form ('what is short falls on the households') would trade an ambiguity for a real floor-1 inference, since the engine affirms the bearer on 189 towns and not on all 260. GENERAL FORM OF THE RULING: where a phrase has a lawful reading and an unlawful one, and the face's OWN neighbouring sentence forces the lawful one, the face passes; a contradiction that depends on the reader choosing against the passage is not a contradiction. 'FORCE' ON THIS BLOCK'S INVASION KEYS IS GARRISON-OR-MILITIA, NEVER THE WATCH. AT TOWN A `Barracks` ROW SEATS THE `garrison` SOURCE WHILE WALLS ARE AN INDEPENDENT COIN, so a garrison face may never presuppose a wall at town. NEVER SPEND A CITATION THE POOL DID NOT ALREADY CARRY — and the PROVENANCE detector has VERB LIMBS a record-scan does not see: `the elders say/hold/remember/keep` is the same shape as `from the road` and cost two faces in batch 4; name the source through a ROLE ('one of the elders has it that') instead. A SPINE CO-RENDERS WITH EVERY FACE OF ITS VARIANT, so no phrase in a spine may echo a phrase in any face of that variant, and no face may open on the same three words as a sibling. DO NOT LAND THE FINAL CLAUSE ON A NEGATION MORE THAN A THIRD OF THE TIME (measured in batch 4: one pool landed 16 of 27 faces on what is NOT there, and a cure that moved every other measure did not move that one); say what IS done and keep the landing noun.
